baslik: How Fire Spreads Faster Than You Can Run
soru: Would you get out in time?
aciklama:
A house fire can go from a spark to deadly in under a minute. Here is the terrifying science of how fire outruns you.

#shorts #science #fire #safety #howitworks

sahneler.metin: A house fire can turn deadly in under a minute.
It starts small, feeding on whatever it can burn.
But fire heats the air, and hot air rises and spreads.
Soon the whole room is so hot that everything ignites at once.
This moment is called flashover, and it is not survivable.
The real killer is not the flames - it is the smoke.
A few breaths of toxic smoke can knock you unconscious.
That is why working smoke alarms cut your risk in half.
In a fire, seconds are the difference between escaping and not.
